name: MariaDB
description: MySQL-compatible database server for websites and apps (port 3306).
notes: root password: ${SECRET}. From Web Station PHP sites connect to 127.0.0.1:3306.
compose:
services:
  mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3306:3306"
    environment:
      - MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=${SECRET}
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/lib/mysql
